effects.name: Smooth temporal change
effects.biological_mechanism: Signed linear, power and saturating programs with independently varied curvature and plateau.
effects.observation_boundary: Rates depend on declared time units; avoid universal monotonicity.

effects.name: Transient induction or repression
effects.biological_mechanism: Signed pulses with varied peak position, width and near-baseline endpoints.
effects.observation_boundary: Unsampled pulses are unobservable; endpoint sign does not define the full response.

effects.name: Delayed activation or repression
effects.biological_mechanism: Signed delayed sigmoids or change points with early, late or out-of-window onset.
effects.observation_boundary: Do not extrapolate precise onset outside sampling support.

effects.name: Biphasic or reversing response
effects.biological_mechanism: Separated signed pulses or sigmoids with unequal phases.
effects.observation_boundary: Phases below sampling resolution are not individually identifiable.

effects.name: Periodic, damped and phase-shifted rhythms
effects.biological_mechanism: Signed oscillations with independently varied damping, phase and period.
effects.observation_boundary: Period and phase require an informative time grid.

effects.name: Nonlinear dose response
effects.biological_mechanism: Vehicle and spaced doses with Hill, Emax, threshold and U-shaped responses.
effects.observation_boundary: Transcript response does not establish binding, benefit, toxicity or a safe dose.

effects.name: Condition by time interaction
effects.biological_mechanism: Distinct baseline, shared time and condition-specific temporal terms.
effects.observation_boundary: A condition association is not automatically a causal disease effect.

effects.name: Null, weak and low-abundance effects
effects.biological_mechanism: Whole null, all-zero controls and independent mean/effect strata.
effects.observation_boundary: Nondetection is not equivalence; failed estimates remain unavailable.

effects.name: Variability or response-mixture change
effects.biological_mechanism: Dispersion or responder-mixture changes with marginal means explicitly matched.
effects.observation_boundary: A variance change is distinct from mean differential expression.

effects.name: Changing tissue composition
effects.biological_mechanism: Cell fractions and per-cell RNA content weight fixed cell-intrinsic expression.
effects.observation_boundary: Cell fractions and RNA fractions differ; absent references restrict attribution.

effects.name: Cell-type-specific responses
effects.biological_mechanism: Within-type responses, rare responders and opposite effects that cancel in bulk.
effects.observation_boundary: Bulk cancellation need not imply absence of cellular response.

effects.name: Donor dependence and repeated sampling
effects.biological_mechanism: Gene-wise donor intercepts, slopes and within-donor correlation.
effects.observation_boundary: Repeated specimens do not create independent donors; marginal means need mean correction.

effects.name: Sex-associated heterogeneity
effects.biological_mechanism: Small baseline and interaction effects in balanced or imbalanced strata.
effects.observation_boundary: Supported associations do not justify universal dimorphism.

effects.name: Genotype and response heterogeneity
effects.biological_mechanism: Allele-dosage associations, shared eQTL modules and genotype interactions.
effects.observation_boundary: LD or omitted variables prevent unique variant causality claims.

effects.name: Covariance and shared causes
effects.biological_mechanism: Mean-corrected latent factors, signed loadings and covariance-only condition changes.
effects.observation_boundary: Residual correlation and co-expression do not establish direct regulation.

effects.name: Bifurcation and branch programs
effects.biological_mechanism: Shared early path followed by two fates with branch-specific expression.
effects.observation_boundary: Snapshot geometry alone does not establish direction or ancestry.

effects.name: Convergent or indistinguishable histories
effects.biological_mechanism: Distinct early paths converge, optionally retaining history tags.
effects.observation_boundary: Unmarked indistinguishable terminal states cannot identify unique origins.

effects.name: Rare states and biased sampling
effects.biological_mechanism: Vary rare-state fractions, capture, proliferation and missing intermediates.
effects.observation_boundary: Observed abundance is not transition rate, fate probability or population fraction without assumptions.

effects.name: Cycle and asynchronous maturation
effects.biological_mechanism: Independent or correlated cyclic and maturation coordinates with variable speed.
effects.observation_boundary: The requested coordinate determines whether cycle is target or nuisance; age is not universal pseudotime.

effects.name: Regulatory evidence layers
effects.biological_mechanism: Latent activities, overlapping/decoy regulons and matched-background motif-hit tables.
effects.observation_boundary: TF RNA, co-expression, annotation, motif occurrence and binding have distinct scopes.

effects.name: Intervention and epistasis
effects.biological_mechanism: Randomized assignment in an explicit structural system with efficacy, indirect cascades and double perturbations.
effects.observation_boundary: Assignment, successful intervention, total response and direct edges remain distinct.

effects.name: Partial confounding
effects.biological_mechanism: Overlapping imbalanced batch-by-biology allocation with batch-only effects.
effects.observation_boundary: Full rank does not establish precise or causal inference.

effects.name: Complete aliasing and invalid contrast
effects.biological_mechanism: Exact covariate aliasing or missing contrast cells with observationally matched explanations.
effects.observation_boundary: Dropping a confounder does not identify an adjusted effect.

effects.name: Composition and absolute-scale ambiguity
effects.biological_mechanism: Dominant transcripts, global directional change and fixed-total sampling with control variants.
effects.observation_boundary: Relative abundance cannot establish molecules per cell without valid scale anchors.

effects.name: Technical repeats and pseudoreplication
effects.biological_mechanism: Libraries nested in specimens, cells in donors, one-unit and unknown-identity designs.
effects.observation_boundary: Unique sample labels do not establish independent biological replication.

effects.name: Outliers and contamination
effects.biological_mechanism: Sparse bulk inflation, low-quality libraries, ambient admixture and summed doublets.
effects.observation_boundary: Extreme biology and technical corruption require separate controls.

effects.name: Missingness and irregular support
effects.biological_mechanism: MCAR, covariate-dependent MAR and latent-response MNAR sample removal.
effects.observation_boundary: Observed data alone generally cannot distinguish MAR from MNAR or reconstruct missing outcomes.

effects.name: Protocol-dependent detection limits
effects.biological_mechanism: UMI sampling without extra dropout; separately justified non-UMI censoring or hurdle processes.
effects.observation_boundary: High zero fraction alone does not prove technical dropout.

effects.name: Distribution and assay transport
effects.biological_mechanism: Matched-moment NB and Poisson-lognormal, heavy tails and separate continuous observations.
effects.observation_boundary: Normalized expression must not be rounded into counts; moment matching is not universal realism.

effects.name: RNA quality and feature bias
effects.biological_mechanism: Sample quality interacts with gene susceptibility, protocol, length or GC features.
effects.observation_boundary: Quality aligned with biology may be unidentifiable; do not blindly remove the target.
